title: Jiu-Jitsu as a Family Activity in Hyannis
desc: Why more Cape Cod families are training martial arts together, and how it strengthens connections at home.
html:

Kids

Jiu-Jitsu as a Family Activity in Hyannis

September 20, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Busy families often spend evenings driving kids to separate activities. Martial arts is one place where the whole family can share the same passion.

Shared goals

Parents and kids can both work toward their next stripe and celebrate each other's progress.

Healthy role modeling

When kids see parents learning something new and sticking with it, they learn that growth never stops.

Simpler schedules

Having kids and adults train at the same academy makes evenings easier.

Something to talk about

Families end up practicing moves in the living room and talking about class over dinner.

A family-friendly environment

At Cristyan Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy, our family-friendly community in Hyannis welcomes parents and children from across Cape Cod.

Train with us in Hyannis

Visit us at 1513 Iyannough Rd, Hyannis MA 02601 or call (508) 364-7697.
